# Darshan Pania

> Director of Engineering at CleverTap. I build mobile SDKs and engineering teams.
> 13+ years on mobile platforms, customer-engagement infrastructure, and AI-native developer tooling.
> I write about engineering leadership, AI workflows, mobile development, and sci-fi.

## Writing (selected)

- [The Liberation Project: Part II — Open Source Savior](https://lostmeanderingthoughts.substack.com/p/the-liberation-project-part-ii-open): Sci-fi — AI agents, token economy, open-source activism
- [The Liberation Project: Part 1 — The Token Heir](https://lostmeanderingthoughts.substack.com/p/the-liberation-project-part-1-the): Sci-fi — inherited wealth in a monetised AI economy
- [Creating Push Notifications in Android O — Part 1](https://tech.clevertap.com/creating-push-notifications-in-android-o-part-1/): Technical guide on Android notification channels
- [Creating Push Notifications in Android O — Part 2](https://tech.clevertap.com/creating-push-notifications-in-android-o-part-2/): Technical guide on notification styles and groups
- [Custom Layouts for your Push Notification](https://medium.com/android-news/custom-layouts-for-your-push-notification-d8219d9962e): Android deep-dive on custom RemoteViews in notifications

## Projects

- [FPLGuru](https://fplguru.com): AI-powered Fantasy Premier League assistant — React frontend, Python/RAG backend, Pinecone vector store, GPT-4o
- [Raindrop.io MCP Server](https://github.com/darshanpania/raindrop-io-mcp-server): MCP server exposing Raindrop.io bookmark management to LLM agents over HTTP/SSE
- [Notificity](https://github.com/darshanpania/Notificity): Android app for capturing and categorising push notifications — Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, open-source
- [RainSurfer](https://rainsurfer.darshanpania.me): Web app to rediscover saved Raindrop.io articles — OAuth 2.0, random article surfacing
